name: webflix
description: WebFlix video workspace — the WebFlix (YouTube-clone) interface as a ZCode workspace panel: home feed, shorts, search, watch and channel pages over a verified snapshot dataset. Official ZCode plugin.

description_i18n.en: WebFlix video workspace — the WebFlix (YouTube-clone) interface as a ZCode workspace panel: home feed, shorts, search, watch and channel pages over a verified snapshot dataset.
description_i18n.zh-CN: WebFlix 视频工作区——把 WebFlix（YouTube 风格）界面带进 ZCode 工作区面板：首页信息流、Shorts、搜索、观看页与频道页，数据来自已校验的快照数据集。ZCode 官方插件。
